'''[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Nic'ala''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], Captain Nic'ala led his special forces unit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] to battle the Empire and expressed concern over [[Starship/Legends|starship]] development that the Imperials conducted in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]. Their efforts to retake Balmorra had become dangerous due to the production of new stealth bombers that had been developed. His subordinate, [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Derrik Reed]], had produced several overload modules that would short out the bombers' electrical systems, which they convinced a fellow Republic citizen to deploy and use.
